source: make 3d interact able game with rounds. a random players avatar is chosen and every player becomes them, player name tags are removed during rounds. players have to guess who the original player is because everyone looks the same. create soft rustic lobby area with dim lamps and fancy seats you can sit in. rounds will occur in a hotel like building with similar easthetic, everyone will teleport here when round begins. rounds last 3 minutes, during which everyone can select who is the real player, all players who guess correctly gain a point. when times up or everyone has voted round ends. when round ends a collapsable results display is shown before everyone is teleported to lobby. during round everyone Is named a number from 1 up to 10 depending on number of players instead of their name tag.

image_prompt.text: A soft rustic lobby where players gather between rounds, dim lamps and fancy seats arranged for the full server without bottlenecking at the exits
A prominent wall in the rustic lobby sized to host the running point totals
An out-of-play corner of the hotel for players who are done, styled to match
a hotel-like building of rooms and corridors in the same soft rustic aesthetic, fully separated from the lobby
fancy armchairs and couches players can actually sit in, lit by dim table lamps

layout_placement.text: The markers that move everyone from the rustic lobby into the hotel at round start and back again at round end
Detection regions registering a point for each player who identifies the original avatar

notes: The hotel stage is an interior; if players ever walk into it rather than teleporting, the route also needs P3.
Scoring in this game is a vote rather than a place a player stands - the preset's scoring volume is carried but has nothing spatial to detect.
Nobody is eliminated during a round, so the preset's spectator area has no population until the round ends.

open_questions.ask: How big is the hotel - a handful of rooms players can sweep in three minutes, or a large building they can get lost in?
Is the hotel one shared space everyone mills around in, or should it have separate rooms that split the group up while they guess?

theme: Soft rustic - warm wood, dim lamplight, fancy upholstered seating

answers.ask: How big is the hotel - a handful of rooms players can sweep in three minutes, or a large building they can get lost in?
answers.answer: Use a small hotel with a handful of rooms and connected hallways that players can sweep within the three-minute round.

answers.ask: Is the hotel one shared space everyone mills around in, or should it have separate rooms that split the group up while they guess?
answers.answer: Make it one shared hotel space with separate rooms connected by hallways, so players can move around and observe each other without being isolated.
